videos.title: R2AK 2028: For the love of the game
videos.description: For over a decade, Race to Alaska has quietly collected a drawer full of complaints about fairness, most of them pointing to one thing: human-powered teams racing for glory while everyone else raced for $10,000. So we opened the drawer. This playful investigation follows the race organizers as they dig into the grievances and roll out a brand new prize structure. Did they solve the problem? Not exactly. But they did reorganize it, trading one set of frustrations for an entirely new one.

videos.title: Polly Wales
videos.description:
“It feels like an intergalactic cult”

Combining her skills as a sculptor, her love of traditional casting methods and her craftsmanship, Los Angeles designer Polly Wales creates one-of-a-kind jewelry. Sapphires, rubies and diamonds are cast directly into rich gold, so the finished pieces resemble natural gem-encrusted forms or sparkling geodes split open. Her unorthodox approach has carved out a new niche in fine jewelry design.

videos.title: MILAMORE FINE JEWELRY
videos.description: We sat down with George in his SoHo home, followed him through the streets and subways of New York, and paired those moments with footage from his atelier in Japan. The result is a portrait of a designer whose work, like his story, moves between cultures, connecting the energy of the city with the patience and precision of traditional craft.

videos.title: Vinátta - Poulsbo 48 Hour Film Challenge
videos.description:
A sailor and his son set course for Poulsbo, Washington. Our submission for the 2025 Poulsbo 47.7 Hour Film Challenge, and the audience choice award winner! 

We were assigned our film parameters at 6 PM on Friday, February 28th, and had until 6 PM on Sunday to submit our final film.

Prop: A doughnut from Sluys Bakery
Location: Spice & Tea Exchange
Line: "This must be my lucky day"

Friday night after the opening event, we set sail to a nearby anchorage, choosing to capture the story chronologically on Saturday. Aside from a few quick pickups on Sunday, what you see in the film unfolded in the same order it was experienced. All the music was composed by Chad during filming. We had a great time–it felt less like a challenge and more like capturing the moments we’d be having anyway. 

We are incredibly grateful to everyone who felt the heart in our story. Winning the Audience Choice Award means the world to us.

videos.title: TWIST Curated Jewelry
videos.description:
TWIST is the direct result of the deep connection owners Paul Schneider and Lauren Eulau have with professional artists and designers. From their earlier lives as a potter and a weaver who sold their art for a living, they have built an ever-changing collection of finely curated designer jewelry and wearable art, grounded in close relationships and mutual respect with each artist.

Based in Portland, Oregon, TWIST was recognized in 2018 when Paul Schneider received the Cindy Edelstein Award at COUTURE, honoring a long-standing dedication to artist and designer jewelry.

videos.title: Odesza - In Return Tour
videos.description: Tour announcement film for Odesza’s 2014 In Return tour, made with Digital Twigs and featuring Lauryn Myers.

videos.title: Graphic Products - ToroMax
videos.description: LocalEyes brought us on to direct and shoot this product film for Graphic Products, introducing the ToroMax printer and showing it at work in the warehouse and out on the job site.

videos.title: Samsung Galaxy S6 - BTS
videos.description:
Behind the scenes look at director GMUNK's practical in-camera techniques used to showcase the Samsung Galaxy S6 Edge.

"The process for this clip was highly technical, as it was mostly executed using motion-controlled cinematography along with macro lenses using very short focus distances. We had to tightly synchronize these two major elements with an array of Laser Projectors. Add in the backlit LED screens shining through the acrylic lettering and you have a set full of expensive gear and a lot of moving parts."

videos.title: Prounis
videos.description: New York designer Jean Prounis draws on ancient forms and her own heritage, hand-making jewelry from recycled 22K gold and responsibly sourced stones. Her pieces are quiet, timeless and made to be passed down: modern heirlooms.

videos.title: Lizzie Mandler
videos.description: Raised in a family of artists and encouraged to follow her creative dreams, Lizzie Mandler pursued the creation of jewelry since the age of 16. After completing her studies in Florence, Italy she moved back to her native Los Angeles to launch her collection of finely hand-crafted jewelry in gold and diamonds. Inspired by the notion that jewelry is forever, her designs strive to surpass trends and seasons.

videos.title: Seattle Credit Union with Jonah Coleman
videos.description: UW running back Jonah Coleman brings the same discipline to his finances that he brings to the football field. Produced with LocalEyes for Seattle Credit Union, this spot shares Jonah’s story and why he chose a credit union that matches his drive for growth.

videos.title: TrueCar L.E.D - Case Study
videos.description: Behind the scenes of TrueCar L.E.D., an interactive light installation directed by GMUNK for the 2015 Twilight Concert Series on the Santa Monica Pier. We captured the build and the live event as concertgoers’ text messages, photos and the music on stage drove a mirrored sculpture holding more than 60,000 LEDs, sending pulses of light across the pier.

videos.title: Jane Diaz
videos.description: New York City native Jane Diaz has been collaborating with Nepalese metalsmiths for over fifteen years to create her ultra-wearable, affordable and craft-influenced jewelry collection. Her world travels and background studying cultural anthropology have inspired her to make sure traditional Nepalese fabrication techniques are incorporated into each piece of jewelry. The bold forms, intricate detail and solid metals are balanced by her worldly aesthetic vision.

videos.title: Silverwood School
videos.description: Silverwood School is an independent K-8 school in Poulsbo, Washington, where 85 students learn, play, and grow on a 17-acre campus in the woods. As the school geared up for its Annual Fund drive, they reached out to explore creating a video that would inspire their community to give.

videos.title: Monica Rossi: Anaconda
videos.description: MILAN - For over thirty years, Monica Rossi has been designing and creating Anaconda jewelry - a collection of intricately hand-crafted jewelry spanning from Italian Baroque inspired to Victorian masterpieces to the most simple of geometric settings. The delicate, but strong, harmony found in her jewelry has a striking purity and balanced lightness. The 19 karat gold has a diffused, warm-toned color balancing the hand-selected stones with their natural imperfections and characteristics.

videos.title: Nikolle Radi: The Platinum Alchemist
videos.description: Raised around his father’s jewelry workshop in Croatia, New York designer Nikolle Radi brings an engineer’s precision to platinum. His intricate openwork pushes the metal into near-impossible patterns, balancing delicacy with structural strength.

videos.title: Sophie Bille Brahe
videos.description: Copenhagen designer Sophie Bille Brahe pairs Scandinavian simplicity with pearls, diamonds and gold, shaping them into fluid, sculptural forms. Her jewelry is clean and poetic at once, a fresh take on fine jewelry.

videos.title: Dorette
videos.description: Paris designer Catherine Lévy built Dorette from a playful curiosity for materials, shaped by design studies in Paris and years of travel through India. Her pieces pair saturated gemstones and organic shapes with the restraint of French provincial jewelry: layered, colorful and deeply personal.

videos.title: Honda of Burlington
videos.description: Instead of scripted testimonials, we asked the team at Honda of Burlington to read their own customers’ Google reviews out loud, on camera. The result is genuine, unpolished reactions from the people behind the dealership: real reviews, from real people.

videos.title: North Coast Credit Union
videos.description: For North Coast Credit Union, we filmed real people from the Bellingham community using online banking in their everyday lives. No actors, just neighbors showing how the credit union’s digital tools fit into their day.

videos.title: Pippa Small
videos.description: London designer Pippa Small works with exceptional gemstones, found objects and traditional techniques to make jewelry rooted in culture and the natural world. Her pieces carry a talismanic quality and celebrate the beauty of imperfection.

videos.title: Jennie Kwon
videos.description: Los Angeles designer Jennie Kwon left careers in classical music and corporate law to make jewelry. Her pieces are delicate but precise, built on fine proportion and subtle diamond settings, and made to be worn every day.

videos.title: Ellie Top
videos.description: A portrait of jewelry designer Ellie Top, filmed for TWIST’s designer series.

videos.title: Disa Allsopp
videos.description: Originally from Barbados, London-based Disa Allsopp forges, reticulates and patinates 18K gold and silver into richly textured, hand-worked surfaces. Influences from the Caribbean and East Africa come through in bold compositions and saturated gemstones.

videos.title: Sia Taylor
videos.description: Working from her studio in Somerset, England, Sia Taylor brings a sculptor’s eye to delicate gold jewelry inspired by seeds, leaves and grasses. Her work finds beauty in the smallest natural details.

videos.title: Joseph Brooks
videos.description: Shaped by Los Angeles’ music and creative culture, Joseph Brooks makes bold, hand-woven bracelets inspired by a lifelong love of gemstones and birdwatching around the world. His work has a devoted following among artists, musicians and collectors.

videos.title: White Aspen Glamping
videos.description: For Stout Tent’s customer story series, we headed to Leavenworth, Washington to meet Brandy and her dad, Mike, who run a glamping getaway built around Stout tents. Rather than just film the setup, we stayed the night in one of their tents and got the full experience as guests. Spending that time with them gave the film an honest, firsthand feel for the business they’ve built together and the place they’ve made for others to enjoy.
